Preserve orange fur, white muzzle and tail tip, green patched travel coat, rust scarf, brown trousers/boots, backpack and rolled bedroll. OUTPUT: transparent PNG, portrait 3:4 aspect, precisely SIX columns by EIGHT rows, 48 complete isolated full-body sprites in equal grid cells. Read left to right within each row. 2 LAY: crouch and lean; kneel with forepaws down; lower chest onto side; head rests on paws; sleeping inhale; sleeping exhale. Complete body on ground by column4.
3 MELEE: ready guard; draw attacking paw back with torso anticipation; forward empty-paw strike; full follow-through; draw paw back; return to guard. Body weight and shoulders move, feet remain at same world position.
4 RANGED: raise empty paws; aim both paws forward at chest level; brief backward shoulder recoil; recover aim; lower paws; return ready. No drawn projectile, gun, wand, sparks or muzzle flash.
5 USE: reach toward own belt; bring cupped paw up; raise paw to mouth; use/drink gesture with head tilt; lower paw; return neutral. No bottle drawn, game overlays actual item.
6 HIT: alert brace; impact wince; torso recoils backward; catch balance crouching; straighten; recover guard. No hit stars or blood.
7 DEATH: stagger; knees buckle; tip sideways; contact ground; settle fully; still collapsed with eyes closed. Non-graphic, complete clothed body, no gore.
8 UNCONSCIOUS: same fully collapsed closed-eye body resting on paws, six distinct restrained breathing poses in a seamless loop (rest, shallow inhale, fuller inhale, exhale, settle, softer rest). Do not stand up.

Each row must contain exactly six sequential poses. Row7 ends in the same resting attitude as row8. Clear silhouettes and coherent anatomy in all48 cells. Transparent background with real alpha, no checkerboard pattern.
